FN-9JDL1PM-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 201
Committee: Veterans, Military Affairs, and Sponsor: Senator Sam Givhan
Public Safety
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/11/2026
Senate Bill 201 as introduced could increase the obligations of the local boards of education, by
an undetermined amount, dependent on any increases in instructional personnel and/or
classroom space required to accommodate home-schooled or private-school students
participating in Junior Reserve Officers' Training Corps (JROTC) programs, as provided by this
bill.
Page 1

FN-9JDL1PM-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 201
Committee: Veterans, Military Affairs, and Sponsor: Senator Sam Givhan
Public Safety
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/11/2026
Senate Bill 201 as reported by the Committee on Veterans, Military Affairs, and Public Safety
could, beginning with the 2026-2027 school year, increase the obligations of the local boards of
education, by an undetermined amount, dependent on any increases in instructional personnel
and/or classroom space required to accommodate home-schooled or private-school students
participating in Junior Reserve Officers' Training Corps (JROTC) programs, as provided by this
bill.
